Tomato___Healthy.cause: Optimal nutrient balance and steady solar radiation
Tomato___Healthy.organic_treatment: Foliar seaweed kelp extract every 14 days for root immunity.

Tomato___Early_blight.organic_treatment: Spray aerated compost tea or copper soap emulsion every 7 days.
Tomato___Early_blight.chemical_treatment: Apply Chlorothalonil or Mancozeb 75% WP at 2g/L water.

Tomato___Late_blight.organic_treatment: Apply cold-pressed Neem oil spray (15ml / 3L water) every 3 days.
Tomato___Late_blight.chemical_treatment: Apply Copper Hydroxide or Copper Oxychloride barrier spray (2g / 1L water).

Potato___Healthy.cause: Balanced soil moisture and rich organic compost
Potato___Healthy.organic_treatment: Apply straw mulch around hills to keep soil cool and moist.

symptoms: Small brown-black spots with concentric rings
Potato___Early_blight.organic_treatment: Spray copper-based organic liquid fungicide every 7 days.
Potato___Early_blight.chemical_treatment: Apply Azoxystrobin or Difenoconazole spray according to label dose.

symptoms: Rapid leaf drop and stem rotting
Potato___Late_blight.organic_treatment: Root drench with Trichoderma harzianum and foliar Neem oil spray.
Potato___Late_blight.chemical_treatment: Apply Metalaxyl + Mancozeb combination spray immediately.

Pepper__bell___Healthy.cause: Good canopy aeration and balanced calcium levels
Pepper__bell___Healthy.organic_treatment: Apply organic liquid fish emulsion for steady leaf growth.

symptoms: Small water-soaked lesions turning dark brown
Pepper__bell___Bacterial_spot.organic_treatment: Apply fixed copper bactericide combined with liquid soap solution.
Pepper__bell___Bacterial_spot.chemical_treatment: Apply Copper Hydroxide mixed with Mancozeb to prevent resistance.
